title: Smart Data Models - Gaia-X Ontology - EcoTSP
description: https://w3id.org/gaia-x/2.1.11#class/EcoTSP. A Trust Service Provider (TSP) recognized and accepted by an ecosystem to issue various verifiable credentials for a particular trust scope. Subclass of GaiaXEntity per the Gaia-X ontology; inherited properties are documented on the GaiaXEntity model and not repeated here.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'EcoTSP'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

ecoTSPId.description: Property. A DID; it is up to the compliance engine supplied by the respective ecosystem to resolve this DID properly.

ecoIssuesCredentialsOfType.description: Property. Type(s) of credentials issued by an Ecosystem TSP and recognized for a particular TSP for a given trust scope, used the same way as 'type' in the Verifiable Credentials Data Model 2.0.
